Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Shop Assistant - Christmas Store - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a festive retail environment and helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holidays?

For a charming Christmas decoration store in the historic centre of Bruges, we are looking for a full-time Sales Associate who enjoys customer contact and creating a warm shopping experience.

What will you do:

• Welcoming customers and assisting them with their purchases

• Advising customers on Christmas Decorations, ornaments and gifts

• Keeping the store tidy and visually attractive

• Replenishing shelves and displays

• Operating the cash register and handling payments

• Helping with deliveries and unpacking new products

• You speak English and/or Dutch

• Flexible and willing to work weekends

• Previous experience in retail or sales is a plus

As Foreman of the Spacer Production ZZ department, you are responsible for coordinating and supervising the production process. You provide operational leadership to a team of approximately 5 operators and ensure that production runs smoothly and according to quality standards and production targets.

You monitor the production schedule and progress and ensure the efficient use of employees, machines and materials. You perform quality checks, monitor process parameters and take corrective action when necessary.

You are also responsible for maintaining a safe working environment and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. You collect and analyse production data such as output, quality and productivity and report this information clearly to the Production Manager.

From a technical perspective, you carry out minor repairs, identify when components need preventive replacement and independently perform complex machine changeovers

 
• 
Demonstrable experience in a production environment.

 
• 
Good technical knowledge.

 
• 
Practical and hands-on approach.

 
• 
Interest in machinery and willingness to work alongside the production team.

 
• 
Natural leadership skills and the ability to lead by example.

 
• 
Good communication skills in Dutch and English.

 
• 
Ability to train and guide operators according to their knowledge and experience.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving skills.

 
• 
Ability to make decisions under pressure.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Good planning, organisational and prioritisation skills.

jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?

Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.

• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.

• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.

• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.

• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).

• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.

• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.

• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you passionate about data and turning information into valuable business insights?

 

To strengthen our Business Intelligence team, we are looking for a SAP Data & Analytics Consultant. In this role, you will help shape our data-driven future by designing and implementing reporting and analytics solutions across the Joris Ide division.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analytics solutions within the SAP ecosystem.
• Translate business requirements into data models, queries, views, reports and dashboards.
• Work closely with stakeholders across different departments and business levels to understand their reporting needs.
• Implement pragmatic and scalable BI solutions for all companies within the Joris Ide division.
• Support the transition towards a data-driven organisation by promoting Business Intelligence best practices.
• Ensure data quality, consistency and usability across reporting environments.
• Contribute to continuous improvements within our BI landscape and processes.

Your profile

• You have a strong analytical mindset and a conceptual way of thinking.
• You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
• You take initiative and are eager to learn and explore new technologies.
• You have excellent communication skills and can translate business needs into technical solutions.
• You are customer-oriented, result-driven and committed to quality.
• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• You hold a degree in IT, Business or a related field.
• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including data modelling, master data management and ETL processes.
• You have strong knowledge of:
• SAP Business Data Cloud
• SAP Datasphere
• SAP Analytics Cloud
• Experience with SAP BusinessObjects, SAP BW and SAP HANA Views is considered a plus.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an asset.Persoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren
• Digitaal denken
• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Samenwerken

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

Help shape value that lasts through strong governance, effective controls, and continuous improvementAs an Internal Auditor, you play a key role in helping the organization achieve its objectives. You bring a structured and disciplined approach to evaluating and improving risk management, control, and governance processes. Reporting directly to the Group Internal Audit Director, you gain broad exposure across the business and take ownership in identifying risks, strengthening controls, and driving improvement across our global organization. Your responsibilities
 
• Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of controls that address risks across governance, operations, and information systems. 
• Assess internal controls and support the organization in maintaining an effective and efficient control environment. 
• Perform audit reviews through inquiries, interviews, and on-site assessments, using established audit methodologies and guidelines. 
• Analyze compliance with Group standards, policies, and procedures. 
• Support the preparation of audit reports and communicate findings, risks, and improvement recommendations to operational teams and senior management. 
• Gain exposure to all stages of the audit process, including risk assessment, audit planning, internal control testing, and reporting. 
• Identify business risks and highlight opportunities to improve efficiency and strengthen processes. 
• Monitor and follow up on the timely implementation of agreed audit recommendations. 
• Work closely with stakeholders across different functions and locations worldwide. 
• Take ownership of assigned audit activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 

Your profile
 
• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field. 
• Minimum 3 to 4 years of experience in internal and/or external audit or controlling. 
• Strong analytical skills and a critical mindset. 
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. 
• Fluent in English.  
• Good knowledge of MS Office; experience with SAP is a strong asset.
